title: An orchestrator's commit in a worker's worktree gets the item's KB-Work trailer as the worker's commits do
goal: Retrospective of SP-etslk6yu: the orchestrator's two commits on work/ST-f2n2h22c (the gate answer and the copied-back skill staging copies) got no KB-Work trailer from the commit-msg hook, while the worker's own commits carried it, so they had to be redone by hand before land. backlog.py answer --root WORKTREE and the staging copy-back commit the item's files with KB-Work naming the item (or the hook derives it from the work/<id> branch); a test commits in a planted worker worktree and finds the trailer.
